q: Will I lose my low first-mortgage rate?
a: Not with a HELOC or home equity loan. Those are second loans, so your first mortgage stays in place. A cash-out refinance replaces your first mortgage with a new rate, term and payment, so it may not be ideal if your current rate is low. We compare both for your numbers.

q: Can I finance a renovation along with my ADU?
a: Yes. Our ADU & Renovation HELOC can pay for an ADU, a renovation or home repairs. Other loans have their own rules, so we check which one fits your project.

q: Who can qualify for the ADU & Renovation HELOC?
a: Owners of a primary home or an investment property. Salaried, self-employed and retired borrowers can all qualify with documented income. Approval depends on your credit, income, debts and the equity in your home, and you keep some equity after the line is set up. We review your numbers with you before you apply.
